request.query: bounded finitely supported natural multi-indices finite box

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.isBounded
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : BoxIntegral.Box ι), Bornology.IsBounded ↑I

items.name: BoxIntegral.le_hasIntegralVertices_of_isBounded
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] {s : Set (ι → ℝ)}, Bornology.IsBounded s → ∃ B, BoxIntegral.hasIntegralVertices B ∧ s ≤ ↑B

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.isBounded_Icc
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] (I : BoxIntegral.Box ι), Bornology.IsBounded (BoxIntegral.Box.Icc I)

items.name: Behrend.mem_box
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℕ}, x ∈ Behrend.box n d ↔ ∀ (i : Fin n), x i < d

items.name: Finsupp.finite_of_degree_le
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Finite σ] (n : ℕ), {f | Finsupp.degree f ≤ n}.Finite
